Feature: Services offered in and around Padmavathi Hospital

  Scenario Outline: Patients can register and apply for appointments/consultation requests within the specified zone
    Given the patient is located in a Pincode within the 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient registers and applies for an appointment/consultation request
    Then the request should be accepted and the patient should receive a confirmation message

  Scenario Outline: Patients can only register and apply for appointments/consultation requests within the specified zone
    Given the patient is located in a Pincode outside the 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient registers and applies for an appointment/consultation request
    Then the request should be rejected and the patient should receive an error message

  Scenario Outline: Authorized Chemist is available for each Pincode
    Given the patient is located in a Pincode
    When the patient registers and applies for an appointment/consultation request
    Then the request should be routed to the authorized Chemist for that Pincode

  Scenario Outline: Prescription requests are routed to the correct Chemist
    Given the patient is located in a Pincode
    When the patient submits a prescription request
    Then the request should be routed to the authorized Chemist for that Pincode
